source.applicability: Bundled vanilla class baseline, assumed by the maintainer to match the game release at export on 2026-09-27; copied class IDs are export-local and enabled mods may edit vanilla classes

jobs.Name: Warrior
jobs.Description: An attacker and tank hybrid that can use many types of weapons. Wears heavy armor.

jobs.Name: Monk
jobs.Description: An attacker and tank hybrid specializing in unarmed combat. Wears medium armor.

jobs.Name: Rogue
jobs.Description: A pure attacker. Deals very high damage when circumstances are ideal. Wears medium armor.

jobs.Name: Cleric
jobs.Description: A healer that has limited offensive options. Wears light armor.

jobs.Name: Wizard
jobs.Description: A fragile mage that casts powerful spells to deal lots of damage. Wears light armor.

jobs.Name: Warlock
jobs.Description: A healer and mage hybrid. Has a small MP pool. Wears heavy or light armor.

jobs.Name: Fencer
jobs.Description: An attacker that requires no support to perform at maximum efficiency.

jobs.Name: Shaman
jobs.Description: A mage that is proficient in casting both damage and support magic.

jobs.Name: Scholar
jobs.Description: A versatile mage with a spell for almost any situation. Learns its abilities from enemies.

jobs.Name: Aegis
jobs.Description: A pure tank that can take damage for party members without managing Threat.

jobs.Name: Hunter
jobs.Description: An attacker that does not need to worry about AP.

jobs.Name: Chemist
jobs.Description: A healer that also specializes in supporting attackers and mages. Has no damaging abilities.

jobs.Name: Reaper
jobs.Description: An attacker that is also capable of tanking when circumstances are ideal.

jobs.Name: Ninja
jobs.Description: An attacker that also specializes in evasive tanking.

jobs.Name: Nomad
jobs.Description: A versatile mage that can deal either physical or magical damage.

jobs.Name: Dervish
jobs.Description: A self-sustaining mage with powerful spells that deal lots of damage.

jobs.Name: Beatsmith
jobs.Description: An attacker that specializes in supporting the whole party.

jobs.Name: Samurai
jobs.Description: A pure attacker that uses lots of AP to deal lots of damage in a single turn.

jobs.Name: Assassin
jobs.Description: An attacker that can either support or deal very high damage.

jobs.Name: Valkyrie
jobs.Description: A tank that specializes in supporting the whole party.

jobs.Name: Summoner
jobs.Description: A very fragile mage with extremely powerful one-time-use spells.

jobs.Name: Beastmaster
jobs.Description: An attacker with unique abilities and the potential to deal lots of damage.

jobs.Name: Weaver
jobs.Description: A pure support mage with spells that specialize in manipulating turn order.

jobs.Name: Mimic
jobs.Description: An unusual Class with no clear role that can do almost anything when circumstances are ideal.
